milestones.name: Defeat Soul Master
milestones.note: Soul Master is fought in Soul Sanctum on the western side of City of Tears

milestones.name: Defeat Watcher Knights
milestones.note: Watcher Knights are fought in Watcher's Spire on the eastern side of City of Tears

milestones.name: Defeat the Collector
milestones.note: The Collector is fought in the Tower of Love on the eastern side of City of Tears

milestones.name: Defeat a Dreamer
milestones.note: Required for Relic Seeker Lemm to appear at Fountain Square

milestones.name: Enter City of Tears
milestones.note: Accessible via Pilgrim's Way from Forgotten Crossroads through Greenpath, Fog Canyon, and Fungal Wastes

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Enormous cavern below Blue Lake, rain falling inside, towers with lifts, eastern/western divide

zones.name: Fountain Square
zones.fingerprintHint: Centre of City of Tears, memorial fountain to the Hollow Knight, Hornet and Lemm found here

zones.name: Pleasure House
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area in a tower, only Hot Spring in the city, eastern side

zones.name: Watcher's Spire
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area on eastern side, Lurien the Watcher's telescope, home of Watcher Knights boss

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area on eastern side, home of the Collector boss

zones.name: King's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area Stag Station in the very eastern part of the city

zones.name: City Storerooms
zones.fingerprintHint: Special room sub-area, western side, has Stag Station

zones.name: Soul Sanctum
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area on western side, Soul Master boss fought here

zones.name: Blue Lake
zones.fingerprintHint: Body of water above City of Tears

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Starting point of the Pilgrim's Way

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.note: Part of the Pilgrim's Way route to City of Tears

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.note: Part of the Pilgrim's Way route to City of Tears

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.note: Part of the Pilgrim's Way route to City of Tears, just before the western gate of the city

bosses.name: Soul Master
bosses.note: Located in Soul Sanctum on the western side of City of Tears

bosses.name: Watcher Knights
bosses.note: Located in Watcher's Spire on the eastern side of City of Tears

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Located in Tower of Love on the eastern side of City of Tears

objectives.name: Reach Fountain Square and find Hornet
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the centre of City of Tears to encounter Hornet at Fountain Square

objectives.name: Unlock Relic Seeker Lemm
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat one of the Dreamers to make Lemm appear at Fountain Square

objectives.name: Defeat Soul Master in Soul Sanctum
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Soul Sanctum on the western side and defeat the Soul Master boss

objectives.name: Defeat Watcher Knights in Watcher's Spire
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Watcher's Spire on the eastern side and defeat the Watcher Knights boss

objectives.name: Defeat the Collector in Tower of Love
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Tower of Love on the eastern side and defeat the Collector boss

objectives.name: Access King's Station Stag Station
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the very eastern part of City of Tears to reach King's Station

objectives.name: Use the Hot Spring at Pleasure House
objectives.hopDescription: Find the Pleasure House in the eastern towers to access the only Hot Spring in City of Tears
